topic: SQL, PostgreSQL, and Relational Data Modeling
learningObjectives: Explain relational databases, tables, keys, and relationships.
Design normalized database structures for application data.
Construct basic SQL operations for creating and querying data.

activities.title: Relational Database Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore tables, rows, columns, and keys.

content.concept: Relational databases organize structured data into tables connected through keys and relationships.

activities.title: Relationship Mapper
activities.instruction: Connect tables according to their relationships.

content.concept: One-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-many relationships describe how records relate across tables.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: SQL Operation Match
activities.instruction: Match SQL commands to their database operations.

content.concept: SQL commands such as SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE perform common data operations.

activities.title: Database Schema Builder
activities.instruction: Build a normalized schema for a web application.

content.concept: A relational schema separates related data into structured tables while maintaining relationships through keys.
